title: Pre-Whitening and BCJR Posterior Distillation for Bi-LSTM Detection in Faster-than-Nyquist Signaling
abstract: arXiv:2609.07762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recurrent detectors such as bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) networks are low-complexity alternatives to the optimal Bahl-Cocke-Jelinek-Raviv (BCJR) detector for faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) signaling. Motivated by convolutional detectors that build the intersymbol interference (ISI) structure into their architecture, we ask whether processing nested ISI windows in separate recurrent branches improves the bit error rate (BER) of a Bi-LSTM. Across roughly 260 controlled trainings it does not: at a matched parameter budget and a matched readout, the multi-window architecture never significantly beats a plain Bi-LSTM. Nested windowing is an invertible rearrangement that adds no information, extra branches only add bottlenecks, and a distillation diagnostic shows the network is already near optimal for its window. The limitation is therefore the observation model, not the architecture. Keeping the architecture fixed, we pre-whit

translated_title: 超奈奎斯特信号传输中用于Bi-LSTM检测的预白化与BCJR后验蒸馏
translated_abstract: 循环检测器，如双向长短期记忆网络，是超奈奎斯特信号传输中最优的Bahl-Cocke-Jelinek-Raviv（BCJR）检测器的低复杂度替代方案。受将码间干扰（ISI）结构嵌入自身架构的卷积检测器的启发，我们探究在独立的循环分支中处理嵌套的ISI窗口能否改善Bi-LSTM的误码率（BER）。在大约260次受控训练中，结果表明并不能：在匹配的参数预算和匹配的读取层条件下，多窗口架构从未显著优于普通的Bi-LSTM。嵌套窗口化是一种可逆的重新排列，不会增加任何信息；额外的分支只会带来瓶颈；蒸馏诊断表明该网络在其窗口范围内已接近最优。因此，限制因素在于观测模型，而非网络架构。在保持架构不变的前提下，我们对预……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 研究发现在超奈奎斯特信号的Bi-LSTM检测中，多窗口嵌套架构无法提升误码率性能，真正的瓶颈在于观测模型而非网络架构，因此提出通过预白化和BCJR后验蒸馏来改进。
